summary: Round 5 verification-only testing. All four Round-4 fixes verified as FIXED plus the BookingDetail.jsx </Dialog> build fix is intact. Added /app/backend/tests/test_round5_fixes.py (7 tests). Full backend suite: 95/95 pass. issues: Still open from Round 4 (not part of Round-5 scope): date range filters use native browser date inputs showing mm/dd/yyyy instead of shadcn Calendar with id-ID locale; table overflows horizontally at 1920px with the right-most columns clipped at the viewport edge (visible in photographer screenshot)
Still open from Round 4: 'Tanggal' (12/31/2026) and 'Waktu' fields use native pickers - locale mismatch with the Bahasa Indonesia UI

critical_code_review_comments: add_photos() now guards with res.matched_count == 0 -> 404 before re-reading; correct. Minor: the 400 'Tidak ada foto yang ditambahkan' check runs before the existence check, so an empty payload on an unknown booking returns 400 not 404 (acceptable, documented in test).
delete_booking() cascade now covers payments + notifications. If other collections later reference booking_id (e.g. schedule/audit), extract a single cascade helper so it cannot drift again.

delete_photo() using matched_count/modified_count to split 'Booking tidak ditemukan' vs 'Foto tidak ditemukan' is correct; note modified_count==0 would also fire for a concurrent double-delete - fine semantically (404).
Bookings.jsx canManage = ['owner','admin'].includes(user?.role) duplicates the same expression in BookingDetail.jsx - extract a useCanManage() hook (still open from Round 4).
BookingDetail.jsx remains ~420 lines with dialogs inline; split before it grows further.

BookingDetail renders (summary-total Rp 2.000.000), preview-invoice-button opens dialog, Escape closes it, page intact, no error elements. Always re-run tests/cleanup_test_data.py afterwards.
